messages:
elliot: Deploy bot just paused the eu-west canary — post-upgrade hook job failed on 2/3 replicas. deploy-bot: canary paused by policy (hook-failure). logs: job/postupgrade-migrate -> CrashLoopBackOff.
priya: ugh. this is the chart bump that included the job that migrates a tiny feature table, right?
cheng: yes, Chart v2.3.0. The job was added to post-upgrade hook (helm hook). appears to hit permission error reading a secret in the staging ns.
elliot: we have a change window ending in ~2h. options: roll back chart to v2.2.7, pin the canary (keep old chart for stable), or hotfix the job image/secret access.
priya: what's the impact if we roll back? are there migrations that already ran? release-bot: Release 2026-03-22-842: canary started at 1751239000. No DB migrations completed (job exit status non-zero).
cheng: good — migration didn't complete so rollback is safe from a schema pov. but the chart also contains a configmap change that stable depends on (feature flag default).
elliot: quick checklist: 1) rollback chart -> immediate traffic stable, no migrations. 2) pin -> let sequenced rollout wait for ops to provision secret, keeps canary paused. 3) hotfix -> backport small RBAC fix to job image and re-run canary in-window.
priya: can we hotfix in-window? how risky/time-consuming? cheng: build+push hotfix image + update chart values override to use image digest -> ~20-30m if CI not blocked. ops needs to create a namespaced secret otherwise job will hit the same error.
elliot: ops is oncall? @ops please? (ping)
deploy-bot: note: automated rollout policy will auto-rollback if canary remains unhealthy for >60m.
priya: ops oncall (anjali) is offline until 12:30 UTC. change window closes 14:00 UTC. that's cutting it close.
cheng: given timeline, safe move is rollback to v2.2.7 and file a postmortem; then we do hotfix and re-promote tomorrow in the next window.
elliot: agree. we should also update release notes to record the rollback and blocked migration. Priya, can you handle the release-notes blurb?
priya: yeah. draft: "Rollout blocked: Chart v2.3.0 post-upgrade hook job failed in eu-west due to missing secret RBAC. Canary paused and rollout rolled back to v2.2.7 to maintain stability. Hotfix and re-rollout scheduled for next window."
cheng: also add the chart values diff we observed to the notes. snippet:
```
- values.featureX.enabled: true -> true (unchanged)
- postupgrade.job.image: registry.redwood/dev/postupgrade:sha256:abc123 -> registry.redwood/dev/postupgrade:sha256:def456
- postupgrade.job.serviceAccount: old-sa -> new-sa (requires RBAC)
```
elliot: tagging oncall and security to review RBAC change before re-promote. deploy-bot: initiating rollback to v2.2.7 on eu-west canary now.
deploy-bot: rollback started. helm rollback release=payments-euwest to revision=3
deploy-bot: rollback succeeded; canary restored to v2.2.7. healthchecks passing.
priya: released notes drafted and pushed to #release-notes-drafts. adding action items: 1) ops create secret + grant SA access, 2) security review SA change, 3) QA smoke test hotfix image in staging.
cheng: I'll open a PR to backport RBAC fix and change the job to be tolerant if secret missing (no-op) so future hook failures don't block rollouts.
elliot: thanks team. follow-up: re-run canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC after fixes. :thumbsup:
priya: :thumbsup:
